positions.as_written: Expect a knee reconstructed with a single anterolateral bundle graft to retain some laxity near extension, because the structure that restrains there has not been reproduced.
Follow a band to its attachment before naming it.
Treat the bundle as the extension half of the pair.
Consider the posteromedial corner alongside this bundle in any knee with laxity near extension.
Accept that an isolated injury to this bundle is a diagnosis made on imaging rather than on examination, because the restraint it provides is shared.
Preserve the posterior meniscofemoral ligament where it is intact.
